items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: the guys like Nick Fatool, he was on the soundtrack but he couldn’t — he was too busy.

ctx.x: Oh it’s a really touching scene.

Yeah. No I say, I think people are seeing now. Maybe, like his intentions were really good, Jack, and what he was trying to do, even if everything didn’t come off grade A, but you know he got close in a lot of those parts. So yeah, and the fact that it had respect for jazz, I mean guys that play jazz, and he gave us all credits. And so yeah, I did the soundtrack and I was also in the picture. Not all of the guys were, but some, a few of us were also in the picture. Some guys were too busy. See when you’re…
Oh. He had somebody fake his part.
